name: Color Picker
purpose: Edit, choose, and submit an opaque hexadecimal color through a finished text, native chooser, preset, or optional floating composition.
useWhen: A form needs one #rrggbb color value selected through editable text, the browser chooser, named presets, or a popover that combines them.

avoidWhen.condition: The interface only previews a color.
The task requires alpha, gradients, color-space conversion, channels, an eyedropper, or contrast analysis.
avoidWhen.useInstead: an application-owned specialist until Atom releases that behavior

composition: Place Label and Control inside Root; include HiddenInput when the value participates in native form submission.
Compose Trigger with Content for a floating picker, or omit both for inline editing.
Put ColorSwatch.Root inside Trigger and SwatchTrigger for finished previews while the surrounding control carries the accessible name and selected state.

rules.statement: Give Input and NativeInput accessible names through Label or explicit aria-label values.
Provide name to Root and render exactly one HiddenInput when the color must submit.
Use #rgb or #rrggbb; this release intentionally supports opaque hexadecimal values only.
Load styles.css, or core.css plus both color-picker.css and color-swatch.css when swatches are composed.
Give presets human-readable names; do not rely on color alone or a raw hex string when a product name exists.

commonMistakes.mistake: Reimplementing color parsing, picker state, or Popover behavior in Brick or application code.
commonMistakes.correction: Use the Atom-backed ColorPicker parts and controlled props.

commonMistakes.mistake: Naming both Input and HiddenInput for form submission.
commonMistakes.correction: Put name on Root and render one HiddenInput.

commonMistakes.mistake: Assuming Chakra's area, alpha, channel, format, or eyedropper parts exist.
commonMistakes.correction: Stay within the released Brick anatomy and treat richer behavior as Atom-first future work.

validation: Test text, native, preset, controlled, disabled, read-only, invalid, form submit/reset, Escape/focus restoration, light/dark, forced-colors, narrow/zoom, RTL, and non-color selection cues.
